description: Rust port of Python SeleniumBase for browser automation and testing: BaseCase on WebDriver (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, with drivers downloaded automatically), a driverless Chrome DevTools Protocol engine (sb_cdp: Browser, Page, Locator), undetected-Chrome and stealth modes, an MCP server (seleniumbase-mcp), the sbase CLI, and importers that turn Playwright, Puppeteer and Python SeleniumBase tests into Rust. Runs on macOS, Linux and Windows.
rules: The crate is seleniumbase-rs and is imported as seleniumbase_rs; its default features are empty, so enable mcp-server for the MCP server, scrape or impersonate for the stealth scraping layer, and tui for the terminal apps.

Use BaseCase with a BrowserConfig (with_browser, with_headless, with_mode, with_proxy) for SeleniumBase-style tests on WebDriver, and sb_cdp::Browser, Page and Locator to drive Chrome over the DevTools Protocol without a driver.
Every browser call is async: run it on a Tokio runtime with #[tokio::main] or #[tokio::test].
Selectors are strings: CSS by default, XPath when they start with / or (, and :contains(text) works inside any selector.
Errors are SeleniumBaseError; match on its variants rather than on message text.
Call quit() on a BaseCase and close() on an sb_cdp::Browser when done; dropping the last Browser handle kills the process it launched.
docs/parity.md maps each Python SeleniumBase method to its Rust name and says whether it is implemented, composed from other calls, or not applicable.

Install it from GitHub, not crates.io: seleniumbase-rs = { git = "https://github.com/MustCodeAl/seleniumbase-rs", tag = "v0.1.1" }; it needs Rust 1.99 and a C compiler, and docs/building.md lists the system packages each platform and feature needs.
chromedriver, msedgedriver and geckodriver are downloaded to match the installed browser when a session starts; sbase install <driver> fetches one ahead of time, and the sb_cdp engine needs none.
To migrate tests, sbase import-playwright, sbase import-puppeteer and sbase import-python write Rust tests; statements they cannot convert stay as TODO comments with their line numbers.
